Fig. 1. Attack surface in identity document verification pipeline. Attacks occur at five stages: (1) Presentation Attack using printed/screen/manipulated documents at capture, (1’) Digital Injection Attack through content editing post-capture, (2) Input Injection Attack via stream hijacking, (3) Decision Manipulation through score tampering, (4) Record Integrity Attack via log tampering, and (5) Response Manipulation through API spoofing.
